FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Questions about payment tracking

Can I record partial payments?

Yes. The verified marketing configuration includes full and partial payment records.

Does Invonxt process card payments?

This website does not claim built-in online card processing.

Can I see the remaining balance?

Payment records are presented with the outstanding invoice balance.

Can I review overdue invoices?

The application messaging includes paid, unpaid, partial, and overdue status visibility.
